storage: one gzipped JSONL per REPORT date under <archive>/occvolume/ (gz-on-write — ~153k rows/day would be ~18MB plain, ~1MB gz); day-level dedup (a published report date is final)
written_by: server/occVolume.ts archiveOccDay (4h poll over a 5-trading-day window — retries 'not yet published' until day T lands and self-heals brief gaps; eager boot)
source: OCC volume-query (marketdata.theocc.com) — keyless CSV, probed live 2026-07-06. ⚠️ ROLLING 2-YEAR WINDOW (verified verbatim error body): data ages off the back daily — this archive is the only durable copy we will ever have (accumulation substitutes for purchase). Verified shape: quantity,underlying,symbol,actype(C/F/M),porc(P/C),exchange(18 codes),actdate MM/DD/YYYY; ALL errors arrive as HTTP 200 + plain text bodies (classified, never parsed as data); quantity counts EACH CLEARING SIDE — totals are halved, C/M put-call ratios kept side-consistent
license: OCC informational use; redistribution of raw data needs OCC permission — bot-internal use + gated derived signals OK; raw resale requires review (BLOCKED-FOR-MIKE when monetization nears)
attribution: The Options Clearing Corporation (OCC) daily volume

field_map.underlying/symbol: underlying ticker; symbol is the option ROOT (numeric prefixes like 1AAL/2SPY = adjusted series)
field_map.actype: C=customer, F=firm, M=market-maker — the trade-origin split that is this stream's entire value
field_map.porc/exchange/qty: put-or-call, listing exchange, contracts PER CLEARING SIDE (see double-count note)

confidence_model: RAW official cleared-volume data. The customer-vs-market-maker put/call-by-ticker hypothesis (the retired ISEE's successor, uncrowded on small caps) stays gate-locked: gate 1 = one day's totals vs OCC's published daily volume page; gate 2 = customer P/C extremes vs forward returns, discounted for census breadth.
entity_key: date + underlying + symbol + actype + porc + exchange (verified unique across 153,181 rows)
cadence: daily source, published overnight ET; 4h poll; weekends/holidays return 'No record(s) found' (honest no-op)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). DATACORE MAXIMUS census #1 — the archive-now root. A one-time ~500-call 2-year backfill is a SEPARATE session-run task (filed in the census), not the boot path.
